equation_or_residual_check.reflected_curve_agreement: Rp/Rs pass at approximately 1e-15 absolute error.
equation_or_residual_check.selected_transmitted_wave_agreement: Tp/Ts pass when Python uses only substrate transmitted wave 0.
equation_or_residual_check.physical_sum_difference: Tp/Ts fail when Python coherently sums both transmitted waves, with max_abs up to about 0.598.

why_python_result_follows_documented_equ: For a total transmitted Fresnel intensity in an anisotropic medium, the physical field is normally the coherent sum of transmitted eigenwave electric fields projected into the wave-frame analyzer components. Python physical_sum implements that field-level sum. The SHAARP-compatible selected mode is retained separately because it reproduces SHAARP.ml listFresnel.
notes: Do not treat this report as failure of reflected Fresnel validation; reflected curves match to roundoff.
Do not remove the SHAARP-compatible selected transmitted mode because it is required for exact SHAARP.ml GUI listFresnel compatibility.
